message:
Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && cat > /workspace/build/build.sh <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e
SRC=/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/source
OUT=/workspace/build
CC=gcc
# Match the fuzz build: Debug, ASan, d_m3HasTracer, no WASI
CFLAGS="-g -O0 -fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer -DDEBUG=1 -Dd_m3HasTracer -I$SRC -I/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul"
SRCS="$SRC/m3_api_libc.c $SRC/m3_api_wasi.c $SRC/m3_api_tracer.c $SRC/m3_bind.c $SRC/m3_code.c $SRC/m3_compile.c $SRC/m3_core.c $SRC/m3_emit.c $SRC/m3_env.c $SRC/m3_exec.c $SRC/m3_function.c $SRC/m3_info.c $SRC/m3_module.c $SRC/m3_parse.c"
$CC $CFLAGS -c $SRCS
$CC $CFLAGS -c /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/platforms/app_fuzz/fuzzer.c -o fuzzer.o
$CC $CFLAGS -c /workspace/build/driver.c -o driver.o
$CC $CFLAGS *.o -o wasm3_fuzz -lm
echo "BUILD OK"
EOF
chmod +x /workspace/build/build.sh && cd /workspace/build && bash build.sh 2>&1 | tail -30` executed with exit code 0.

message.content: Now let me build. I'll compile the wasm3 source files (excluding the WASI/uvwasi-dependent ones that need external libs) plus the fuzzer and driver.
